decisive_import.author: Charles Bordenave
decisive_import.title: A new proof of Friedman's second eigenvalue Theorem and its extension to random lifts
decisive_import.checked: Corollary 24, page 31; preceding old/new eigenvalue decomposition. The statement was checked directly; the entire spectral theorem was not independently reproved.
decisive_import.imported_claim: For a random lift of a fixed d-regular graph, the largest absolute new adjacency eigenvalue is at most 2 sqrt(d-1)+epsilon with probability tending to one for each fixed epsilon>0.
decisive_import.application_checked: K3,3 is connected, simple and 3-regular; its old spectrum is 3,-3,0,0,0,0. Choosing epsilon=3-2 sqrt(2)-0.08>0 gives base Laplacian gap >=0.08 for suitable lifts. Bipartiteness's old -3 eigenvalue is harmless for lambda_2 of the Laplacian.
decisive_import.not_claimed: The generator does not certify the gap of every finite draw. Numerical eigenvalues are not interval certificates.
